page.notes: Arabic lines transcribed letter by letter where legible. The Arabic phrase after "Ebnol-Kasaio" and the words after "من" are only partly legible; the uncertain word is marked [?]. Several Arabic words in the lines beginning "يقال" and "الاحكام الماخوذة" are smudged by stains and may contain small errors. Printed "Ebnol-Kasaio", "Vi-" and the Latin hyphens are kept as printed. The text ends mid-word on "Vi-" and the catchword "dens," is not repeated in the text. The Latin "Omniscius" is kept with its long s, rendered as s.
